title: Customers without orders
description: Return id and name for every customer that has no orders. Row order does not matter.
starter_sql:
SELECT c.id, c.name
FROM customers AS c
hints: Start with LEFT JOIN: it preserves rows from the left table.
After the join, keep rows where no order was found.
solution_explanation: LEFT JOIN keeps every customer, and o.id IS NULL leaves only customers without matching orders.
